descriptors.concept_name: Characterization of Surplus on Sale of Shares and Securities
descriptors.definition: The characterization of surplus from the sale of shares and securities as either capital gains or business income depends on whether the assets are held as investments or stock-in-trade. This determination relies on factual circumstances, taxpayer intent, and established judicial and regulatory principles.
exclusion: Personal assets subject to statutory exceptions
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between investment holdings yielding capital gains and trading assets yielding business income.
source_ambiguities: The source text truncates at the end, cutting off the specific sub-clauses for assessing stock-in-trade options.
